solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Occultism threatening astrologers, complacent at first

parts.note: black skies or a black look are threatening, menacing
the Magi, the wise men of the Nativity, were astrologers who followed a star

indicators.note: at first asks for only the opening letter of the word complacent

explanation.surface: Someone warns that the occult menaces stargazers who grow too smug.
explanation.definitionFit: Black magic is sorcery practised for evil ends, a branch of occultism.

clue.text: Cockney in to cut deal, one predicting change

indicators.note: to cut means the Cockney word is pushed into the middle of the word for a deal, splitting it

parts.note: to barter is to deal or trade
in means at home; a Cockney drops the H, saying 'ome

explanation.surface: An East Ender sits in on a trade negotiation, a forecaster of change.
explanation.walkthrough: Cockney speech drops the initial H, so 'home' (in, as in 'staying in') becomes 'OME.
explanation.definitionFit: A barometer measures air pressure, and a falling or rising reading predicts a change in the weather.

clue.text: Lead analyst perhaps taking Speaker's role?

parts.note: taking the role of is expressed by as, as in acting as chairman
a sayer is one who says things, a speaker

explanation.surface: A lead analyst wonders whether to step into the role of spokesperson.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lead' reads as leading, but it is the metal: an assayer tests metals such as lead for purity. 'Taking ... role' reads as 'as': in the role of a sayer.
explanation.definitionFit: An assayer analyses ores and metals, so one testing lead is, for example, a lead analyst.

clue.text: Dairy product from East found in Irish province

indicators.note: found in says the compass letter sits inside the name of the province

parts.note: Munster is one of the four provinces of Ireland

explanation.surface: A cheese from the east turns up in the south-west of Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: Muenster is a soft cheese, a product of the dairy, named after a town in Alsace.

clue.text: Organised gang discredits a former leader

indicators.note: organised means the letters are arranged into a new order

explanation.surface: An organised criminal gang sets out to smear a former head of state.
explanation.definitionFit: Valéry Giscard d'Estaing was President of France from 1974 to 1981, a past head of state.

clue.text: Fissure allows the French inside underground chamber

indicators.note: inside says the French article goes within the word for the underground chamber

parts.note: a cave is an underground chamber
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A crack in rock lets French visitors into a cavern.
explanation.definitionFit: Taken as a verb, to fissure is to split, which is what cleave means.

clue.text: One giving partial cover to member in strike

definitions.text: One giving partial cover to member
definitions.meaning: a garment that covers the foot, part of a leg, a limb or member
to hit or punch someone, slang for a blow

explanation.surface: A garment for the foot is mentioned in the middle of a walkout.
explanation.definitionFit: Hosiery covers part of the leg; as a verb it means to punch hard.

clue.text: Move silently, forbidden to speak, beating team

indicators.note: to speak means the words are said aloud and spelt as their sound-alikes

parts.note: to steal is to move silently, and banned means forbidden: steal banned

explanation.surface: Someone banned from speaking creeps quietly away after thrashing the opposition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beating team' looks like a winning side, but it is a group of players who beat drums.
explanation.definitionFit: A Caribbean ensemble plays drums made from oil barrels, a band that beats its instruments.

clue.text: Free from sin, is inclined to enter church

indicators.note: to enter says the phrase for leaning goes inside the abbreviation for church

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
leans means is inclined, tilts

explanation.surface: A believer inclined toward church hopes to be absolved there.
explanation.definitionFit: To purify someone spiritually, washing away wrongdoing, is to make them morally clean.

clue.text: Worried having to work longer hours?

definitions.meaning: uneasy and agitated, unable to settle
read as two words: with less rest, working more

explanation.surface: An employee frets about being made to put in extra time.
explanation.definitionFit: Uneasy, fidgety people cannot keep still; the second sense splits the word into rest plus less.

clue.text: Spaniard, no longer with Man U, quits team

indicators.note: no longer with means those letters are dropped from the name

parts.note: Manuel is the Spanish waiter in the British sitcom Fawlty Towers
Man U is short for Manchester United football club, taken here as its letters
being quits is being even, with no debt either way

explanation.surface: A Spanish footballer leaves Manchester United and walks out on the squad.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a footballer, but the Spaniard is Manuel, the hapless waiter from the 1970s British sitcom Fawlty Towers; take MANU from his name to leave EL.
explanation.definitionFit: Football and cricket sides each field this number of players, so the number names the side.

clue.text: County council leader's last to be ousted

indicators.note: the final letter of the official's title is thrown out

parts.note: a mayor heads a town council

explanation.surface: The head of a county council will be the last one removed from office.
explanation.definitionFit: Mayo is a county in the west of Ireland.

clue.text: Oven's content fed to bird who'd appreciate it?

indicators.note: fed to says the oven letters are put inside the bird

parts.note: a starling is a common bird

indicators.note: content means the inner letters, leaving off the outside of the word oven

explanation.surface: What's cooking in the oven is given to a bird who would relish it.
explanation.definitionFit: A hungry, underfed person would welcome any food that came out of an oven.

clue.text: Mating period over and he's out to grab attention

indicators.note: over means the word for the mating period is turned back to front

parts.note: the rut is the mating season of deer

indicators.note: out signals the letters of and he's are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Once the mating season is finished, a stag leaves to make a showy entrance.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who turns heads draws looks wherever they go, an idiom for catching notice.

clue.text: Entire can spilled that's full of juice

indicators.note: spilled means the letters tumble out into a new order

explanation.surface: A whole can tips over, and what comes out is juicy.
explanation.definitionFit: This smooth-skinned peach is a very juicy fruit.

clue.text: Where, in Massachusetts, engine driver needs stronger drink?

indicators.note: needs stronger drink means the milder beverage inside the power source is swapped for a stronger one

parts.note: steam drives a steam engine
ale is a stronger drink than tea

explanation.surface: A train driver craves something stronger than a cuppa.
explanation.walkthrough: The engine driver is not a person but steam, which drives the engine; replace TEA in it with stronger ALE.
explanation.definitionFit: Salem is a town in Massachusetts, famous for its witch trials of 1692.

clue.text: Cut up heart that fills pastry

parts.note: to mince is to cut up finely
the meat of something is its heart or core

explanation.surface: A butcher chops up a heart to make a pie filling.
explanation.definitionFit: The dried-fruit mixture is the filling of the mince pies eaten at Christmas in Britain.

clue.text: Fish good served alongside two others

parts.note: ray and ling are two other kinds of fish

explanation.surface: A fish is served up nicely with a couple more on the side.
explanation.definitionFit: The grayling is a freshwater game fish related to salmon.

clue.text: Organised church spread

parts.note: to run an event is to organise it, so ran means organised

explanation.surface: A church organised a buffet for its congregation.
explanation.definitionFit: A spread is a large farm or estate, especially in the American West.

clue.text: Roaming free as feline, not caught by mammoth

indicators.note: not means the letter for caught is left out of the cat word

parts.note: a cat is a feline
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
mammoth means huge, large

explanation.surface: A big cat escapes, uncaptured by a vast creature.
explanation.definitionFit: An escaped prisoner still at liberty is said to be on the loose, unconfined.

clue.text: Man woman married and separated from daughter in Skye?

parts.note: he stands for a man
a bride is a woman being married

indicators.note: separated from means the abbreviation for daughter is taken out of and

explanation.surface: A couple wed, and the daughter is left out of the family on a Scottish island.
explanation.definitionFit: Skye is one of the Hebrides, the islands off western Scotland, so anything there belongs to that archipelago.

clue.text: Reformed buccaneer having run away to square sins?

indicators.note: away, after having run, says the letter for run leaves the phrase

parts.note: a reformed buccaneer is a former pirate, an ex-pirate
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A pirate gone straight flees to atone for misdeeds.
explanation.definitionFit: To atone for wrongdoing is to make amends, squaring the account for misdeeds.

clue.text: Invitation to compete with your setter — in flower arrangement?

parts.note: race me! invites someone to compete
the setter refers to themselves as me

explanation.surface: A setter challenges the solver to a contest at a flower show.
explanation.definitionFit: Botanists name this the arrangement of flowers along a central stem, as in a foxglove or hyacinth.

clue.text: Witty style in a new essay following requests

indicators.note: following says the rest of the pieces come after the word for requests

parts.note: pleas are requests
an essay is an attempt, a try

explanation.surface: A clever literary manner appears in a fresh essay written on demand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'essay' is not a composition here but its old sense, an attempt.
explanation.definitionFit: Light banter, jocular or teasing in tone, is the playful way of talking.

clue.text: Satanists' leader breaks mirror in church recess

indicators.note: breaks says the leading letter splits open the word for mirror

parts.note: to ape is to mirror or copy

indicators.note: leader means only the opening letter of the word Satanists

explanation.surface: The head of a satanic cult smashes a mirror in an alcove of a church.
explanation.definitionFit: An apse is the semicircular recess at the east end of a church.

clue.text: Fur coat owner's hesitant admission?

definitions.meaning: the white winter pelt of the stoat, worn as fur

explanation.surface: Someone shyly admits that the fur coat is theirs.
explanation.definitionFit: The winter coat of the stoat is the prized white fur trimming robes; split, it is a sheepish claim.

clue.text: Begin to explain my activity at restaurant?

explanation.definitionFit: To start a process or ceremony is to set it going; split into words, it says I dined inside it.

clue.text: Mike with two Europeans consuming unknown appetisers

parts.note: Mike is M in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: consuming means the pair of letters swallows the unknown

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for European, twice
Z is an unknown quantity in algebra

explanation.surface: Mike and two European friends tuck into some mystery starters.
explanation.definitionFit: Meze are small dishes served before a meal in Greek, Turkish and Middle Eastern cooking.

clue.text: Commitment shown in battle

definitions.meaning: a promise or appointment, as in a prior ... or a betrothal

explanation.definitionFit: A pledge to marry or an arranged appointment is one sense; a military clash is the other.
